terra.problem: “John kept it in the family” implies his disciples were family members, which the passage does not say.
The casserole joke mentions a food that is not in the passage or an answer on the card.
The explanation is flat and repetitive: it restates the answer without adding a distinctive Papa Dorin voice.
The explanation repeats the blessing without offering much explanation or personality.
“Fine clothes belong in a palace, not out in the wilderness” goes beyond Jesus’ statement about where people wearing fine clothing are found.
The passage does not say how far the wilderness was from a palace, so “about as far from a palace as you can get” adds an unsupported detail.
Calling Elijah a prophet of Israel adds a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
Calling Isaiah a prophet adds a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
Calling Jeremiah a prophet adds a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
“No soldiers anywhere in sight” asserts that soldiers were absent, rather than simply noting that Jesus does not mention them.
“Nothing pleases them” generalizes beyond the two responses Jesus describes.
